svg.title: 54 hash chains · 14 steps each
svg.desc: A forest of 54 chains with 14 hash steps each. Groups of three chain endpoints are hashed into 18 group digests; groups of three digests into six subtree digests; these form the public key. A sample disclosure cut is highlighted: blue filled dots are revealed values, blue outlined nodes are recomputed, and grey branches are unused for this cut. The low 128 digest bits select an index below 2^115 in a fixed enumeration of disclosure cuts, each revealing at most 42 values. The drawn cut illustrates this family without claiming a particular digest index.
svg.text: One index selects a whole pattern
Accept i < 2¹¹⁵; otherwise try a new nonce.
Choose subtree values, group values and chain positions · at most 42 values
